import pandas as pd

file_path = '/data/field_visit_log.xlsx'
# Load sheet
xls = pd.ExcelFile(file_path)
print("Sheets:", xls.sheet_names)

df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Visit Log')
print(df.head())
print(df.columns.tolist())
print(len(df))

# Normalize village names (for completeness)
def normalize_village(v):
    if pd.isna(v):
        return ''
    s = str(v).strip()
    # collapse internal whitespace
    import re
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()

df['Village_norm'] = df['Village'].apply(normalize_village)

# Deduplicate Visit ID keeping first occurrence
df_dedup = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
print("Retained rows:", len(df_dedup))

# Check Follow-up Required values
print(df_dedup['Follow-up Required'].value_counts(dropna=False))

# Compute percentage requiring follow-up
# Assume values like 'Yes'/'No' with possible case variation
follow_up_col = df_dedup['Follow-up Required'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
require_follow = follow_up_col == 'yes'
pct = require_follow.mean() * 100
print("Percentage:", pct)

# Round to two decimal places
pct_rounded = round(pct, 2)
print("Rounded:", pct_rounded)

# Normalize village names (not strictly needed for dedup but per instruction)

        return ''
    s = str(v).strip()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()

df['Village_norm'] = df['Village'].apply(normalize_village)

# Deduplicate Visit ID keeping first occurrence
df_dedup = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
print("Retained rows:", len(df_dedup))
print("Total rows original:", len(df))

# Compute percentage requiring follow-up
